services.0.description: Iwebhusayithi yephothifoliyo okanye i-CV yobuqu ukuze uzazise iprofayile yakho, amava akho nomsebenzi wakho ngobuchule.

services.1.description: Iphepha lokufika okanye iprofayile yenkampani eqaliswa ngokukhawuleza, eyenza umbono omhle nelungele ukutsala abathengi.
services.2.title: Inkqubo yolwazi nemisebenzi
services.2.description: Iideshibhodi, iiportal neenkqubo zangaphakathi zokulawula idatha yakho nemisebenzi yemihla ngemihla yeshishini lakho.
services.3.title: Ukuzenzekelisa
services.3.description: Zenzekelise iinkqubo eziphindaphindwayo ezifana neziaziso, ukudibanisa izixhobo nokuhamba komsebenzi ukuze iqela lakho longe ixesha.
process.description: Inyathelo ngalinye linemveliso onokuyibona, uyivavanye uze uyamkele. Uyazi kakuhle ukuba umsebenzi uhamba njani.
process.0.title: Uphando lweemfuno
process.0.description: Siyazichaza iinjongo zeshishini, izalathiso zembonakalo, iimpawu eziphambili nezinto eziza kuqala emsebenzini.
process.1.title: Ukuphonononga uyilo
process.1.description: Ulwakhiwo, uyilo nokuhamba kuphononongwa kwaye kuvunywe ngokudibeneyo phambi kokuvelisa.
process.2.title: Uphuhliso
process.2.description: Iwebhusayithi, i-app okanye ukuzenzekelisa kwakhiwa ngokuziguqulayo ngokweyilo elivunyiweyo.
process.3.title: Ukuphonononga isiphumo
process.3.description: Isiphumo siphononongwa ngokudibeneyo, silungiswe ukuba kuyimfuneko, size sivavanywe de silunge ukuya kuhlala kwi-intanethi.
process.4.title: Ukuqalisa nokunikezela
process.4.description: Imveliso iyapapashwa, i-metadata ne-SEO iyamiselwa, emva koko ufumana ukufikelela nesikhokelo.
services.0.long: Iwebhusayithi yephothifoliyo okanye i-CV yobuqu lilikhaya lakho elisemthethweni kwi-intanethi. Iprofayile yakho, amava akho nomsebenzi wakho zihlanganiswa ngocoselelo kwiphepha elinye elilula ukwabelana nalo nabaqeshi, abathengi okanye iiyunivesithi.
services.0.for: Abagqibe izifundo ngoku nje, abasebenzi ngokuzimeleyo, abadali nabanobuchule abafuna ukubonakala bethembekile.
services.1.long: Iphepha lokufika okanye iprofayile yenkampani inceda ishishini ukuba lenze umbono omhle wokuqala. Senza ukuhamba kwephepha, isicatshulwa nembonakalo ukuze iindwendwe zikuqonde ngokukhawuleza oko ukunikelayo kwaye zivuseleleke ukunxibelelana nawe.
services.1.detail.3: Ukumisela i-SEO ukuze ufumaneke lula kuGoogle
services.1.detail.4: Kukhawuleza ukuqalisa xa izinto zakho zilungile
services.1.for: Amashishini, izikolo, iikhefi, uluntu neenkampani ezifuna ukubonakala zinobuchule.
services.2.long: Inkqubo yolwazi icoca umsebenzi ngoku otyhalwe kwiishiti zokubala, kwiinqaku nakwiincoko. Idatha ihlala kwindawo enye, ifikelelwa ngokweendima, kwaye iingxelo zinokubonwa nanini na.
services.2.detail.0: Ukuhamba komsebenzi okucocekileyo okulandela indlela osebenza ngayo
services.2.for: Izikolo, amaziko, iivenkile, iifama neenkampani ezifuna ukulawula idatha ngendlela ecwangcisiweyo ngakumbi.
services.3.long: Imisebenzi ephindaphindwayo efana nokuthumela iziaziso, ukuhambisa idatha phakathi kwee-app okanye ukwenza iingxelo eziqhelekileyo inokuziqhuba ngokwayo. Iqela lakho longa ixesha kwaye lisinda kwiimpazamo zokuchwetheza.
services.3.for: Amashishini namaqela anomsebenzi omninzi ophindaphindwayo wesandla.
process.0.long: Phambi kokwakha nantoni na, sifuna ukuliqonda ishishini lakho: yintoni injongo, ngobani iindwendwe, kwaye ziziphi iimpawu ezibalulekileyo. Ukusuka apho sibeka izinto eziza kuqala ukuze umsebenzi uhlale ugxile kwaye kungalahlwa mali.
process.0.you: Sixelele iimfuno zakho wabelane ngemizekelo yeewebhusayithi oyithandayo.
process.0.result: Uluhlu lweemfuno nezinto eziza kuqala ezivunyelwene ngokudibeneyo.
process.1.long: Siqala ngokucwangcisa ulwakhiwo lamaphepha nomfanekiso wembonakalo. Unokuyiphonononga uphe uluvo phambi kokuba kuqalise ukwakhiwa, ukuze isiphumo sokugqibela sihlale sisondele kuko obukucinga.
process.1.you: Phonononga uyilo, uze unike impendulo okanye imvume.
process.1.result: Uyilo olwavunyelwana ngokudibeneyo phambi kokuba kuqalise ukuveliswa.
process.2.long: Xa uyilo selivunyiwe, iwebhusayithi, i-app okanye ukuzenzekelisa kuyakhiwa. Iziguqula kwiifowuni nakwiikhompyuter, kwaye unokwabelana ngempendulo ngelixa umsebenzi uqhubeka.
process.2.do.1: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ibonakala kakuhle kwiifowuni, kwiitablethi nakwiikhompyuter
process.2.do.2: Ukumisela izinto ezisisiseko ukuze ufumaneke lula kuGoogle
process.2.you: Lungiselela imibhalo, iifoto neelogo, wabelane ngempendulo xa unayo.
process.2.result: Uhlobo lokuqala onokulivavanya. Iwebhusayithi elula idla ngokugqitywa kwiintsuku zomsebenzi ezi-1–3 xa izinto zilungile.
process.3.long: Sivavanya isiphumo sidibene. Nantoni na engalunganga kakuhle iyaphinda ilungiswe, emva koko yonke into ivavanywe kwakhona de isebenze kakuhle kwizixhobo ezahlukeneyo kwaye ilunge ukuya kuhlala kwi-intanethi.
process.3.do.3: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke into ilungele ukuqaliswa
process.3.you: Vavanya isiphumo usixelele into ofuna ilungiswe.
process.4.long: Imveliso iyapapashwa ivulwe wonke umntu. Siyilungiselela ukuze ifumaneke lula kuGoogle, emva koko sinikezele ngokufikelela kunye nesikhokelo sokusebenzisa ukuze uyilawule ngokukhululekileyo.
process.4.do.3: Ukukuxhasa ngonyaka omnye wokulondoloza simahla, kunye nedomeyini (iphakheji Encinci) okanye indawo yokubamba iwebhusayithi (iphakheji Enkulu)
process.4.you: Gcina ukufikelela kwakho kukhuselekile uze uqalise ukwabelana nabathengi bakho.
process.4.result: Iwebhusayithi okanye i-app ikwi-intanethi kwaye ilungele ukusetyenziswa.

faq.title: Imibuzo edla ngokuvela phambi kokuqalisa.
faq.description: Ukuba umbuzo wakho awuphenduwanga apha, intlanganiso yengcebiso inokunceda ekuchongeni iimfuno zakho.
faq.0.question: Zeziphi iinkonzo ezinokwenziwa yiNocoding?
faq.0.answer: Senza iiwebhusayithi zephothifoliyo okanye ze-CV yobuqu, amaphepha okufika okanye iiprofayile zeenkampani, iinkqubo zolwazi nemisebenzi, nokuzenzekelisa iinkqubo zeshishini.
faq.1.question: Uthatha ixesha elingakanani uphuhliso?
faq.1.answer: Iphothifoliyo yobuqu, i-CV okanye iphepha lokufika elilula idla ngokuthatha iintsuku zomsebenzi ezi-1-3 emva kokuba izinto zilungile. Iiprojekthi ezinkulu zixhomekeke kwiimfuno zeempawu, ukudibanisa nesantya sempendulo.
faq.2.question: Ingaba uyilo neempawu zinokulungiswa?
faq.2.answer: Ewe. Uyilo, ulwakhiwo lwamaphepha, iimpawu nokuhamba komsebenzi zinokulungiswa ngokweemfuno zakho. Uyilo luphononongwa ngokudibeneyo phambi kokuba kuqalise uphuhliso.
faq.3.question: Yintoni equkethwe lixabiso?
faq.3.answer: Ixabiso liquka uphuhliso ngokweephakheji nobubanzi obuvunyelweneyo. Iphakheji Encinci iquka ukulondoloza simahla nedomeyini unyaka omnye, ngelixa iphakheji Enkulu iquka ukulondoloza simahla nokubamba iwebhusayithi unyaka omnye.
contact.title: Sixelele iimfuno zeewebhusayithi yakho. Siza kunceda ucoce indlela.
contact.description: Thumela isishwankathelo esifutshane seshishini lakho, amaphepha owafunayo nexesha olifunayo. Impendulo yokuqala iza kuquka iingcebiso ngobubanzi namanyathelo alandelayo. Iingcebiso zihlala zisimahla, nanini na xa uzifuna.
footer.tagline: Iiwebhusayithi zeshishini ezilungele ukuqaliswa, ezibonakala zinobuchule kwaye ziyakhula lula.
project.description.ecoswap: Intengiso kwi-intanethi yokuthenga nokuthengisa izinto ezisetyenzisiweyo. Abantu banokuthumela, bakhangele bathenge ngokulula kwifowuni okanye kwikhompyuter.
project.description.wiboost: Ivenkile kwi-intanethi yeenkonzo zedijithali ezifana nokongeza imali kwiigeyimu, iipakheji zedatha nee-app eziphambili, ezinebhalansi yabathengi nenkqubo yabathengisi kwakhona.
project.description.ahawi: Iwebhusayithi yephothifoliyo yobuqu ngesimbo sokupeyinta ngamanzi enezilwimi ezimbini, ukuze kuzaziswe iprofayile, amava neenkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano.
project.description.abdi: Inkqubo yeerekhodi yezicaka zebhotwe (abdi dalem) leKeraton yaseSurakarta: ukubhalisa, idatha yobuqu, iishedyuli zemisebenzi, ukubakho nokushicilela amakhadi esazisi.
project.description.sfarm: I-app yokulawula ifama yeenkukhu ezifaka amaqanda neebhokhwe elawulwa lilali: iirekhodi zemihla ngemihla, intengiso, iindleko neengxelo zemali.
project.description.payu: Iqonga elidibanisa abantu abapapasha imisebenzi nabasebenzi abazimeleyo. Abapapashi bahlawula umvuzo, abasebenzi abazimeleyo bagqibe umsebenzi, kwaye intlawulo yenziwa nge-QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Ikhathalogu kwi-intanethi enamawaka eemveliso. Abathengi banokukhangela, bakhethe baze benze i-odolo ngqo nge-WhatsApp.
project.description.ianprem: Ivenkile kwi-intanethi yeeakhawunti zee-app eziphambili ezifana neNetflix neSpotify. Abathengi bakhetha baze bahlawule ngokwabo, ngelixa abalawuli belawula isitokhwe nentengiso.
project.description.alengka: Ikhathalogu kwi-intanethi yefenitshala yangaphakathi nangaphandle yeekhefi, iirestyu namakhaya. Iindwendwe zinokukhangela ingqokelela zibonisane nge-WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Iwebhusayithi esemthethweni yesikolo samabanga aphantsi eneprofayile yesikolo, ulwazi lokwamkelwa kwabafundi abatsha, uluhlu lootitshala, imisebenzi engaphandle kwegumbi lokufundela nempumelelo yabafundi.
project.description.furnix: Ikhathalogu kwi-intanethi yefenitshala yentsimbi evela eJepara yeekhefi, iirestyu namakhaya. Iindwendwe zinokukhetha iimveliso zenze i-odolo ngokuthanda kwazo.
project.description.clothique: Ivenkile epheleleyo yempahla kwi-intanethi: ikhathalogu, ikharityhulu yokuthenga, intlawulo kwi-intanethi, ibhlog nendawo yolawulo yokulawula ii-odolo neengxelo.
project.description.agli: Isixhobo samaqela omxholo sokuqokelela imizekelo yomxholo obonwe kakhulu, sibone iipateni size sibhale imibhalo yeposti entsha.
project.description.nebulist: Umncedisi wentengiso osebenzisa i-AI owenza isicwangciso, amanqaku ngabathengi abanokubakho kunye nemibhalo yemiyalezo yokunxibelelana, ngokusekelwe kulwazi lwemveliso.
project.description.carbonfi: I-app yezemali zedijithali yokurhweba ngiikhredithi zekhabhoni (imivuzo yokunciphisa ukukhutshwa) neenkqubo zemivuzo ethanda okusingqongileyo.
project.description.protectedpay: I-app ekhuselekileyo yokuthumela imali yedijithali: imali ikhululwa kuphela xa ifunyenwe, kunye neentlawulo zeqela nokonga.
project.description.pedulichain: Iqonga leminikelo elibonakalayo: umnikelo ngamnye nendlela esetyenziswa ngayo imali ikhutshwa rekhodi ngokusisigxina kwaye ibonakala kuye nawuphi na umntu.
project.description.astra: Umncedisi we-AI onokuxoxa naye ukulawula izinto zedijithali, ezifana nokuthumela iitokeni okanye ukwenza izinto zedijithali ezixabisekileyo, ngaphandle kokwazi ukubhala ikhowudi.
project.description.auditfi: Isixhobo sokukhangela ukhuseleko esisekwe kwi-AI seenkqubo zezemali zedijithali esifumana iindawo ezibuthathaka size sibhale ingxelo kwimizuzwana.
project.description.p2p: Iqonga lokutshintshisana ngezinto zedijithali ngqo phakathi kwabasebenzisi, ngokukhuselwa kwemisebenzi nendawo yolawulo yokuqhuba iqonga.
project.description.payguppy: I-app encedisa iivenkile eziqhelekileyo ukwamkela iintlawulo ngemali yedijithali zisebenzisa iikhowudi ze-QR ezinazo kakade.
project.description.tiptap: Iqonga labadali bomxholo lokufumana iithiphu kubabukeli ngemali yedijithali okanye ngezinto zedijithali ezixabisekileyo, ngeziaziso ngexesha leendaleko ezibukhoma.
project.description.senkus: Igeyimu kwi-intanethi enomxholo wesayensi nokwenza ubugqi: abadlali bahlanganisa iipotshini, baqokelele izinto zedijithali baze bakhuphisane kwindawo yokulwa.
project.description.quickstock: I-app yekhompyuter yokulawula isitokhwe sevenkile yempahla: irekhoda intengiso, ukuhanjiswa kwabahlinzeki neengxelo zesitokhwe, ngokufikelela okusekwe kwindima yomsebenzi ngamnye.
project.description.caer: Iqonga lokuboleka nokuboleka izinto zedijithali ngaphakathi kwamanethiwekhi ngenkxaso ye-rupiah yedijithali ye-IDRX, yenze kube lula ukonga nokuboleka.
